title: BaO2/Mn2O3/ZnO/BaMnO3 nanocomposite: structural, optical, spectral, morphological and antibacterial properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15430-15440
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00680A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Adnan Alnehia, Mohamed E. El Sayed, Mohammad N. Murshed, Abduelwhab B. Alwany, Ahmed Samir
This work presents the synthesis of a novel BaO2/Mn2O3/ZnO/BaMnO3 nanocomposite via co-precipitation using solely distilled water, followed by calcination at 500 °C for two hours, with detailed characterization.
